mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility raises weekday footfall and spillover shopping within four weeks, so RETAIL_REC rises after a sustained recovery in commuting activity.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior four-week mean after WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks and remains above its immediately preceding week.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT below its recent low signals tighter travel restrictions or weaker public movement, which reduces discretionary retail visits within one week and keeps RETAIL_REC lower.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -50 and stays there for at least one weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week average within one week after TRANSIT crosses below -50 and does not remain depressed.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are depressed, trip chaining and at-home substitution dominate, so retail and recreation activity stays below baseline over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises for two consecutive weeks despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above baseline and both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining well below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PARKS mobility diverts leisure time outdoors rather than into malls and restaurants, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks after park-going improves.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 0 after being negative in the prior weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days after PARKS turns positive and stays positive for at least one weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains near zero or negative while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline, households are staying home and substituting essentials trips only, which suppresses discretionary retail demand within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is negative for two consecutive weekly means while RESIDENTIAL stays above 5
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior two-week mean when GROCERY_PHARM is negative twice in a row and RESIDENTIAL stays above 5.

mechanism_narrative: A partial recovery in TRANSIT without a matching recovery in WORKPLACES indicates commuting friction rather than broad reopening, and that pattern weakens retail visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises week-on-week while WORKPLACES remains below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT improves while WORKPLACES stays below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS combined with improving TRANSIT creates outing intensity that spills into retail visits, so RETAIL_REC rises within one week when both series improve together.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns positive and TRANSIT improves by at least 5 points in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase within one week after PARKS turns positive and TRANSIT improves by at least 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: During winter or holiday periods, rising grocery activity and stable residential stay-at-home behavior reduce discretionary shopping trips, so retail and recreation mobility declines over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM is rising and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above baseline.
